message: No detected input validation: There are no schema checks, dtype assertions, or value-range guards on the incoming data; only basic CLI argument string comparisons are performed before passing data through the pipeline.
No detected untrusted source handling: Data is loaded from local file paths configured via JSON with no checksum verification, authentication, or integrity checks for any remote or untrusted source.

No detected label flipping detection: No code checks label distributions, validates label values against an expected set, or uses any label-noise detection tool such as Cleanlab anywhere in the data preparation pipeline.

No detected data poisoning defenses: The preparation pipeline (Generator, Engineer) only performs loading, preprocessing, feature engineering, and embedding with no outlier detection, statistical anomaly checks, or filtering of suspicious training samples.

No detected model integrity verification: No hash checks, signature verification, or pinned revision controls are present when loading pretrained embeddings (GloVe, FastText, Word2Vec, Doc2Vec) or any serialized model artifacts.
No detected label distribution validation: No code checks label distribution, class balance, or expected label sets before or during training anywhere in the visible pipeline.
No detected backdoor or trigger detection: There is no neural-cleanse, activation-pattern analysis, gradient anomaly detection, or any other backdoor/trigger defense implemented in the training code.
No detected differential privacy: No differential privacy libraries (Opacus, TensorFlow Privacy, DP-SGD) or mechanisms are imported or used anywhere in the visible code.
No detected adversarial robustness testing: No adversarial robustness testing frameworks (Foolbox, ART, FGSM, PGD, etc.) are imported or invoked anywhere in the pipeline code.

No detected metric tampering protection: There is no evidence of a held-out test set isolated from training, hashed/signed evaluation data, or use of multiple independent metrics to guard against metric manipulation.

No detected input sanitization: The code only validates CLI arguments (model name, text_represent, feature_select, normalize) against allowed string lists, but there is no shape, range, schema, or content validation of actual inference input data passed to the model.
No detected output bounds checks: There is no code inspecting model outputs for NaN values, probability bounds, or threshold sanity checks anywhere in the visible inference/training path.

No detected prompt injection defenses: The pipeline uses anomaly detection models (Isolation Forest, LOF, OCSVM, etc.) on tabular/embedded data, not an LLM, so prompt injection defenses are not applicable and none are present.
